determinism.description: Four same-input-same-output controls, because this act's whole evidence chain rests on comparing bytes across it. (i) The build is deterministic by construction (fixed ZipInfo date_time), so source_code_hash is a function of content; the chain is kept unbroken by UPLOADING THE VERIFIED ZIP BY COPY rather than rebuilding for the upload. (ii) The artifact the closure was diffed against was proven to BE the running bytes, not merely to share a version label. (iii) The M-1 key derivation was proven invariant to the lib/opal_naming.py change that landed after the halves were signed -- a real hazard, since the derivation routes through opal_naming. (iv) The limb-7 ticker list was pinned so the series comparison measures the function, not the ranking's drift.

mutant.description: THE NEGATIVE ARM, WITH ITS ONE GAP STATED RATHER THAN DRESSED UP. Three real falsifiers fired in this cell, and one was not exercised. (a) THE BUILD REFUSED, and the world supplied the failing state rather than a planted edit: at the then-current CLOUD HEAD 48a5b4a1cf the build stopped at its own drift guard before packaging anything. The order's BOUNDS 1 makes a gate refusal a REFUSAL, so it was diagnosed, not worked around. (b) The limb equalities carry a control proving the two captures straddle a real code change. (c) Limb 7's generated_at exception is proven confined by leaf enumeration, not inferred from this cell's own normaliser, which could have hidden a second change. (d) THE GAP: this cell did NOT re-run AC1-AC4 against the pre-act world.

(c) if only generated_at moved, every other leaf path is identical; if anything else moved, the enumeration names it. (d) the strongest form would see each of AC1-AC4 FAIL pre-apply.

This NARROWS the closure to the halves' nine rather than widening it. (b) Um3BOJ+j at 01:21:27Z -> pVa+sgzj at 01:58:03Z, CODE MOVED True. Coherence: all four /print and all four /timeline digests are byte-identical to this seat's xx-4 post-apply captures of 22:30Z, so the comparands were stable across rounds and not coincidentally equal within this one. (c) rankings 72 leaf paths, EXACTLY 1 differing -- /generated_at '2026-09-30T01:22Z' -> '2026-09-30T01:58Z'; timeseries 426 leaf paths, EXACTLY 1 differing, the same field. Every row field and series point identical. (d) NOT DONE.
